scope: Image card hover and focus ergonomics across the public stream, My Creations, and Favorites. Local implementation review and production build; no production deployment or authenticated browser session claimed.
decision: Use image-first progressive disclosure. Cards remain a single browse target with lightweight creator or ratio context; prompt text and action clusters move to the deliberate detail inspector.
implementation: Removed prompt text, duplicate hide/like controls, copy/download controls and Remix/Reuse clusters from card hover states in the public stream and saved studio grids.
Kept card tap, keyboard focus and the existing detail inspector as the clear entry point for full prompt, copy, download, reuse, like, hide and share actions.
Added a visible focus ring and removed now-unused hover overlay/action styles, reducing competing affordances without removing the underlying capabilities.

checks.docs_impact: mapped runtime changes to images and client-efficiency; surface brief, maintainer note and this retained evidence remain explicit unmapped documentation paths and were reviewed separately

limits: No live production browser session, physical-device pass, or deployment was performed in this local change.
